docs.title: ChatNet
docs.text:
ChatNet 提供 ChatArch 通用网络/门户 helper：ping/TCP 扫描、URL 收集和检查、浏览器服务健康检查、服务 URL 处理、浏览器式 session/cookie 状态，以及非 sudo 显式 forward proxy 服务。

ECNU 这类应用层门户逻辑属于 ChatECNU；ChatNet 只保留应用无关的网络基础能力。

docs.title: 常用入口
docs.text:
chatnet --help
chatnet --tree
chatnet --tree-brief
chatnet links --url https://example.com
chatnet proxy autostart print --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 18080 --allow-cidr 172.23.0.0/16 --user chatnet

完整树包含参数签名，简版树保留相同注册命令和用途说明。两者都由 ChatStyle 共享渲染器生成，不输出密码或 token 值。

docs.text: • CLI 树：真实注册命令树、验收条目和更新规则。

├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.

├── ping [--network NETWORK] [--concurrency CONCURRENCY] [--output OUTPUT]  # Scan hosts with ICMP; sends network traffic and may write --output.
├── proxy  # Run explicit proxy helpers; credentials stay masked.
│   ├── autostart  # Create non-sudo user systemd autostart artifacts.
│   │   ├── install [--service-name SERVICE-NAME] [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--env-file ENV-FILE] [--python PYTHON-BIN] [--enable] [--interactive]  # Write a user systemd unit and optionally enable it.
│   │   └── print [--service-name SERVICE-NAME] [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--env-file ENV-FILE] [--python PYTHON-BIN] [--interactive]  # Render a user systemd unit; read-only text output.
│   ├── check [--proxy-url PROXY-URL] [--url TARGET-URL] [--user USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--expect-status EXPECT-STATUS] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--show-body] [--interactive]  # Check a URL via proxy; sends a request and redacts the proxy URL.
│   └── serve [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--interactive]  # Serve a forward proxy; long-running listener with no secret output.
├── recovery  # Diagnose and recover locally; settings come from ChatEnv.
│   ├── check [--json-output]  # Check the configured link; never change network state.
│   ├── logs [--limit LIMIT] [--status STATUS] [--incident-id INCIDENT-ID] [--json-output]  # Read retained private recovery events; never inspect hardware.
│   └── run [--execute] [--json-output]  # Plan a recovery, or execute it with safety and budget checks.
├── services [--chromium-url CHROMIUM-URL] [--chromium-token CHROMIUM-TOKEN] [--chromedriver-url CHROMEDRIVER-URL] [--playwright-url PLAYWRIGHT-URL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]  # Check browser services; sends requests and redacts Chromium tokens.
└── ssh [--input INPUT-FILE] [--network NETWORK] [--port PORT] [--concurrency CONCURRENCY] [--output OUTPUT]  # Scan TCP ports; sends network traffic and may write --output.

docs.title: 验收条目
docs.text:
• chatnet --help 必须显示 --tree 和 --tree-brief。
  • chatnet --tree 必须列出 ping、ssh、links、services、proxy serve/check/autostart print/install 和 recovery check/logs/run。
  • chatnet --tree-brief 必须保留相同命令和用途说明，但不显示参数签名。
  • 输出不得包含已迁出的 ecnu 业务命令，也不得包含模板 hello 命令。
  • 密码和 token 只能以选项名出现；值不得写入树或运行摘要。
  • 新增/删除 CLI 命令时，同步更新注册表测试、本页和 README。

docs.title: 离线网络恢复
docs.text: ChatNet 为 Linux + NetworkManager 提供一次性诊断和受保护的恢复；它不会启动后台看门狗，也不宣称修复硬件根因。

docs.title: 日常命令
docs.text:
chatnet recovery check
chatnet recovery check --json-output
chatnet recovery run                         # 只读预演
chatnet recovery run --execute --json-output # 执行一次受保护恢复
chatnet recovery logs --limit 100
chatnet recovery logs --status failed --json-output
chatnet recovery logs --incident-id <uuid>

诊断不健康或执行失败时返回非零。check 会读取网络状态，但不读取或写入恢复状态；预演也不创建状态。每次 run --execute 都写入原生结果，包括健康空操作、安全阻止和检查错误。链路健康时不重置网络；本地网关仍可达时，公网探测单点失败不会触发恢复。

docs.title: ChatEnv 配置
docs.text:
配置归属既有 ChatEnv ChatNet schema；进程环境优先于活动 profile。日常 CLI 不接收网卡、驱动或机器参数。

CHATNET_RECOVERY_INTERFACE=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_CONNECTION=saved-wifi
CHATNET_RECOVERY_RESCUE_PEER=192.0.2.1
CHATNET_RECOVERY_PROBE_HOST=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MODULE_RELOAD=true
CHATNET_RECOVERY_COOLDOWN=300
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3
CHATNET_RECOVERY_WINDOW=3600

以上连接和地址仅为示例，应替换为已核验的本地值。INTERFACE 留空时必须只有一个无线接口；CONNECTION 留空时必须能唯一选择已保存的 Wi-Fi profile。模块重载默认关闭；模块名只从内核证据推导，不能通过 CLI 指定。救援对端必须经带 carrier 的独立物理以太网接口到达。

不要提供 Wi-Fi 密码。恢复只复用 NetworkManager 的既有 profile，不读取或修改认证信息。通过 ChatEnv 管理 profile，再用 chatenv test -t chatnet -I 做不修改网络的配置校验。

docs.title: 恢复路径和保护
docs.text:
命令保护当前 SSH 路径，并在首次修改网络前持久化冷却和每小时预算。未启用模块模式时，只执行有界 Wi-Fi 扫描、激活选定连接并复查网关。模块模式还要求独立有线救援路径、完整非空的物理身份和仅绑定该适配器的驱动，再依次执行模块卸载、模块加载、设备等待、既有连接激活和复查。每个命令与复查都在开始前持久化 stage-started，完成后写入 stage-finished 及净化后的返回码；未匹配的开始记录明确表示该阶段未确认完成。只有实际活动连接 UUID 等于尝试目标，设备实例、指纹和 profile 身份一致，且网关复查成功，才返回 status=recovered；recovered_at 是复查实际完成时间。诊断中的 connection_uuid 是选定的保存连接，active_connection_uuid 是现场活动连接，不用配置值替代现场事实。

接口存在时的一次 execute 观察可以缓存私有恢复身份：接口、已保存 profile 的指纹（UUID、类型、名称和绑定）、内核设备路径和实例、内核身份指纹以及推导出的模块。接口随后消失时，只有全部证据仍一致才会考虑模块模式恢复：内核设备仍存在、没有替换设备占位、模块未控制其他设备、profile 选择未改变，并且有线救援及 SSH 检查仍安全。缺少身份或旧状态没有身份、硬件移除或更换、profile 改变、模块共享、管理路由不安全时一律拒绝修改。ChatNet 不从接口名猜驱动、不接受模块选项，也不猜设备。

这个回退路径有意保持狭窄：sysfs 中已消失的硬件、内核设备实例已改变的硬件，或核验模块重载后接口仍未返回的情况都不能恢复。真实 USB/驱动行为依赖硬件，仍需操作员现场验证。

执行要求既有非交互 sudo 权限。工具不安装 sudoers、不静默提权、不重启 NetworkManager 或主机、不替换固件/驱动、不联网下载，也不执行调用方提供的任意命令。

docs.title: 持久事件和保留边界
docs.text:
$CHATARCH_HOME/envs/ChatNet/       # 既有 ChatEnv profile
$CHATARCH_HOME/chatnet/recovery/  # 锁、预算、缓存身份和事件

未设置 CHATARCH_HOME 时使用 ~/.chatarch。目录和文件仅所有者可访问。状态损坏、权限不安全、事件 JSON 形状错误或时钟回退都会停止执行；原始子进程 stderr 永不写入或返回。

事件包含 epoch、带时区时间、run_id、不健康期间持久的 incident_id，以及实际尝试的 attempt_id，并记录净化后的诊断、动作、阶段结果和终态。detected_at 是首次观察到不健康的时间，不是猜测的物理断线时间。失败和阻止保持在同一开放 incident，直到观察到健康；之后再次复发会创建新 incident。健康空操作始终为 performed=false。被中断的尝试保留已落盘的 attempt-started（及活动状态），但没有成功的 attempt-finished；后续健康也不会倒推该尝试成功。

保留量有限：8 个 JSONL 分段，每段以 1 MiB 为轮转目标（约 8 MiB，另加至多一个有界事件）。recovery logs 安全读取全部仍保留的分段，默认返回最新 100 条，--limit 范围为 1 到 1000。状态和 incident 过滤只作用于保留范围，不能找回已轮转删除的历史。升级时会严格识别并继续保留 0.2.4 之前的元数据行，但它们没有可信的 run/incident 身份，因此不进入新版 API 结果。Python 调用方可使用 chatnet.recovery 中的 check_recovery()、recover_network(execute=False)、read_recovery_logs() 和 recovery_home()。

已安装包不依赖源码 checkout。后台 watch/service 不属于本命令面。

docs.title: ChatNet
docs.text:
ChatNet provides generic ChatArch network and portal helper primitives: ping/TCP scans, URL collection and checks, browser-service health checks, service URL helpers, browser-like session/cookie state, and non-sudo explicit forward proxy helpers.

Application-level ECNU portal logic belongs in ChatECNU; ChatNet stays application-neutral.

docs.title: Common entrypoints
docs.text:
chatnet --help
chatnet --tree
chatnet --tree-brief
chatnet links --url https://example.com
chatnet proxy autostart print --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 18080 --allow-cidr 172.23.0.0/16 --user chatnet

The full tree includes signatures; the brief tree keeps the same registered commands and purpose summaries. Both use ChatStyle's shared renderer and never print password or token values.

docs.title: Acceptance checklist
docs.text:
• chatnet --help must expose --tree and --tree-brief.
  • chatnet --tree must list ping, ssh, links, services, nested proxy serve/check/autostart print/install, and recovery check/logs/run.
  • chatnet --tree-brief must retain the same commands and purpose summaries while omitting signatures.
  • The output must not contain the migrated ecnu application commands or the scaffold hello command.
  • Passwords and tokens may appear only as option names; values must never enter tree output or runtime summaries.
  • When commands are added or removed, update registry tests, this page, and README together.

docs.title: Offline network recovery
docs.text: ChatNet provides one-shot diagnosis and guarded recovery on Linux with NetworkManager. It does not start a watchdog or claim to repair the hardware fault.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
chatnet recovery check
chatnet recovery check --json-output
chatnet recovery run                         # read-only plan
chatnet recovery run --execute --json-output # one guarded attempt
chatnet recovery logs --limit 100
chatnet recovery logs --status failed --json-output
chatnet recovery logs --incident-id <uuid>

An unhealthy check or failed recovery exits nonzero. check inspects the network but never reads or writes recovery state. A dry run also creates no state. Every run --execute invocation records a native result, including healthy no-ops, blocked attempts, and inspection errors. A healthy link is never reset, and a failed optional external probe does not trigger repair while the local gateway remains reachable.

docs.title: ChatEnv configuration
docs.text:
Use the existing ChatNet provider. Process environment overrides the active profile; hardware options do not belong in daily CLI arguments.

CHATNET_RECOVERY_INTERFACE=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_CONNECTION=saved-wifi
CHATNET_RECOVERY_RESCUE_PEER=192.0.2.1
CHATNET_RECOVERY_PROBE_HOST=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MODULE_RELOAD=true
CHATNET_RECOVERY_COOLDOWN=300
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3
CHATNET_RECOVERY_WINDOW=3600

Replace the example connection and peer with verified local values. An empty interface requires exactly one wireless interface. An empty connection requires an unambiguous saved Wi-Fi profile. Module reload defaults to false; the module is derived from kernel evidence and cannot be supplied as a CLI option. The rescue peer must route through an independent physical Ethernet interface with carrier.

Do not provide Wi-Fi passwords. Recovery reuses an existing NetworkManager profile without reading or changing its authentication. Manage the profile through ChatEnv, then use chatenv test -t chatnet -I for configuration validation without network mutation.

docs.title: Guarded recovery
docs.text:
The command protects the foreground SSH path and persists the cooldown/hourly budget before its first mutation. Without module mode, it runs a bounded Wi-Fi rescan, activates the selected saved connection, and postchecks the gateway. Module mode also requires independent wired rescue, complete nonempty physical identity, and a driver bound to that adapter alone. Each command and postcheck persists stage-started before execution and stage-finished afterward with sanitized return codes; unmatched starts mean completion was not confirmed. status=recovered requires the actual active connection UUID to match the attempted target, matching physical instance/fingerprint and saved-profile identity, and a successful gateway postcheck. recovered_at is that postcheck's actual completion time. connection_uuid describes the selected saved profile; active_connection_uuid describes the observed active profile, never a substitution from configuration.

An execute observation made while the interface is present may cache a private recovery identity: interface, a saved-profile fingerprint (UUID, type, name, and binding), kernel device path and instance, kernel identity fingerprint, and derived module. If that interface later disappears, module-mode recovery is considered only when all of that evidence still matches. The kernel device must still exist, no replacement may occupy it, the module may control no other device, the saved profile selection must be unchanged, and the Ethernet/SSH safety checks must still pass. Missing or legacy identity, removed or replaced hardware, a changed profile, a shared module, or an unsafe management route blocks mutation. ChatNet never derives a driver from an interface name, accepts module options, or guesses a device.

This fallback is deliberately narrow. It cannot recover hardware that has vanished from sysfs, a device whose kernel instance changed, or an interface that does not return after the verified module reload. Live USB/driver behavior remains hardware-specific and must be validated by an operator.

Existing noninteractive sudo permissions are required for execution. The package does not install sudoers, silently escalate privileges, restart NetworkManager or the host, replace firmware/drivers, download dependencies, or execute caller-supplied commands.

docs.title: Durable events and retention
docs.text:
Profiles remain in $CHATARCH_HOME/envs/ChatNet/; locks, budgets, cached identity, and events use $CHATARCH_HOME/chatnet/recovery/. The default home is ~/.chatarch. Directories and files are owner-only. Corrupt state, unsafe permissions, malformed event JSON, or a regressed clock fails closed; raw subprocess stderr is never stored or returned.

Events contain an epoch and timezone-qualified timestamp, run_id, a persistent incident_id for unhealthy observations, and attempt_id for actual attempts. They also carry the sanitized diagnosis, planned actions, stage outcomes, and terminal result. detected_at is the first observed unhealthy time, not an estimated physical disconnect time. Failures and blocks remain in the same open incident until a healthy observation; a later relapse starts another incident. Healthy no-ops always have performed=false. An interrupted attempt retains its durable attempt-started event (and active state) without an attempt-finished success; later health never rewrites that attempt as successful.

Retention is finite: eight JSONL segments with a 1 MiB rotation target (roughly 8 MiB plus at most one bounded event). recovery logs reads all retained segments safely, returns the newest 100 events by default, and accepts limits from 1 through 1000. Status and incident filters apply within retained data; they cannot recover rotated-out history. Recognized pre-0.2.4 metadata-only lines remain on disk through normal rotation but are omitted from versioned API results because they have no trustworthy run or incident identity. Python callers can use check_recovery(), recover_network(execute=False), read_recovery_logs(), and recovery_home() from chatnet.recovery.

The installed package does not depend on a source checkout. Background watch/service commands remain outside this command surface.
